annotations.title: Bind a Google Analytics property to a project

description: Link (or repoint) a project's Google Analytics property. `propertyId` is re-validated against the caller's LIVE property list on every call — fails if the property fell out of the connected account's access since it was last listed via list_ga4_properties.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

propertyId.description: Bare numeric GA4 property id (no 'properties/' prefix), taken verbatim from list_ga4_properties.

name: set_ga4_property
